patterns.note: The site uses full-bleed, high-fashion photography as background elements, often overlaid with large, bold typography or acting as distinct section dividers.
A dramatic contrast in typography is used, featuring extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif headings for impact, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A striking warm orange is used as a primary accent color, dominating the footer and modal pop-ups, providing a strong visual anchor against a largely monochrome (black and white) content area.
The hero section features large, bold text that parallaxes or moves at a different speed than the background image as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic reveal effect for the collection title.
Major content sections are clearly delineated by full-width background changes, alternating between full-bleed imagery, solid white, and the prominent accent orange.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where oversized text layers move independently over a full-bleed background image, creating a sense of depth and dynamic reveal as the user scrolls. This is likely achieved using a scroll-triggered animation library like locomotive-scroll.

A persistent navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing continuous access to site navigation. Additionally, a subtle informational bar sticks to the bottom of the viewport while the hero section is in view.
Modal pop-ups for promotions and service requests are used, appearing centered over a semi-transparent overlay, ensuring user focus on the call to action or form.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed display headings (~5-6x body text) create a strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, legible sans-serif for body text and uppercase navigation labels.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, editorial aesthetic, driven by the dramatic use of oversized, condensed typography in the hero section that interacts dynamically with full-bleed, high-fashion photography. The unexpected and prominent use of a warm orange as a primary accent color for key interactive elements and the footer also sets it apart from typical minimalist luxury brands.
